from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Define the evolutionary traits
evolutionary_traits = ['BEL_evol', 'MBL_evol', 'OGP_evol', 'RES_evol', 'RML_evol']

# Perform regression for each evolutionary trait
results = {}
for trait in evolutionary_traits:
    X = df[[trait]].values.reshape(-1, 1)
    y = df['BAMM_speciation'].values

    # Fit the model
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)

    # Get the coefficient
    coefficient = model.coef_[0]

    # Add p-value using statsmodels
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    model_sm = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
    p_value = model_sm.pvalues[1]

    results[trait] = {'coefficient': coefficient, 'p_value': p_value}

results
